data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers spanning the Biotech & Health sector, with 3 same-stage private comps (Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B) serving as primary anchors.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $180M total raised as a baseline proxy, applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $306M. Peer-median analysis of the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a $3.8B implied valuation, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Precision Neuroscience's revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S of 6.2x across public biotech names lacks a target denominator.

The two-method triangulation supports a range of $260M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around (i) whether peers like Colossal represent true sector comparables or outlier valuations, and (ii) the gap between capital-raised-based methods and peer multiples. Stage-progression yields the conservative bound; peer-median dominates the center and upper range. Revenue-based valuation would materially narrow this band if disclosed.
